description: Predict, Measure, Collapse (fz-k8w) was written because the Output Contract Loop was forgotten: rules.md pointed at a 'strategy trigger' in .agent/strategies.md that did not exist. The two strategies run the same loop; PMC added two ideas (the work is part of the contract; evidence discipline -- fixed prediction, discriminating probes) and a lot of process (per-case readers, repeated base checks, gates). Rebuild OCL as Paper First with those ideas, delete both old pages, give every strategies.md entry a 'Use when' trigger, and have rules.md name the trigger directly.
title: Fold Predict, Measure, Collapse into the Output Contract Loop as Paper First, with use-when triggers
